data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word μαρνάω (marnao), meaning 'to strive, to work hard, to serve'. In Christian tradition, Marna is associated with the grace and love of God. The name Marna carries the meaning “God's grace, love” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Marna usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace, love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Marna belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's grace, love.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Marna total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
